notes.title: Update to v1.0.1
notes.content: - The time counter that decreases during the game is now saved, and the time is carried over to the next time you start the game.

notes.title: v1.0 Updated
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where PAW levels would not increase. Please feel free to exchange cats.
[*] Fixed a bug where the SE would sometimes sound multiple times. Please enjoy the sound of the waves more.
[*] Implemented an installation card. The game instructions are now displayed when the game starts.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9 Updated
notes.content:
[h1]GEAR=D Cats Fishing For Cats ver 0.9 Updated[/h1]
  
[Cats Fishing for Cats](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3231850?utm_source=hp) has been updated to ver 0.9.  
  
[h2] v0.9 Update[/h2]

[list]
[*][Update] The CPU usage rate was abnormally high, so we reviewed it.  
[*][Update] We adjusted the layout of the inventory.  
[*][Update] We fixed the design of the elements in the inventory.  
[/list]


[h2] Known Bugs [/h2]

[list]
[*]There have been reports that PAW levels do not increase even when 100 PAW points have been collected.  
  - Please keep the cats without exchanging them.  
  - We will fix this as soon as we identify the cause.  
[*]There have been reports that some cats do not appear on the pier even when equipped.  
  - They may appear after a few repetitions.  
[/list]

[h2] Next update [/h2] 
- We will implement Japanese and English installation cards, and add a function to display the game content at the start of the game according to the language set in Steam.  
  
We accept feedback on Discord and on the Steam Community forums.
